rationale: The filing presents a final schedule-wide Total Portfolio Investments row of 6,342,711 thousand, after the non-controlled/non-affiliated, non-controlled/affiliated, and controlled/affiliated categories. The balance sheet independently reports the identical total investments at fair value. It equals the companyfacts value, is below total assets of 6,695,908 thousand, and represents 94.72% of total assets, leaving a plausible 353,197 thousand non-investment remainder. The companyfacts tag therefore captured the complete portfolio total, not merely a non-affiliated subtotal.
